Each building is a newly fabricated steel structure from our Bengaluru and Greater Noida facilities, supplied in the six approved building sizes, 60x24 ft G+1 at the small end and 120x24 ft G+2 at the large, sleeping 58 to 216 workers each on the standard planning basis. descriptionHtml:
Labour Colony, Built as a Site, Delivered as Buildings

A labour colony from SAMAN is worker housing planned as a whole site and delivered as finished steel buildings. The dormitories on this page come out of our Bengaluru and Greater Noida factories as newly fabricated structures, and around them the rest of a working colony takes shape: toilet and bath blocks matched to headcount, kitchen and dining space, drinking water points, gate cabins and internal lighting. Across 500+ projects in 15+ states we have learned where colonies actually fail, and it is rarely the steel. It is drainage that cannot take a monsoon, stairs that jam at shift change, boards mounted where no electrician can reach. This page exists so none of that reaches your site.

What Counts as a Labour Colony?

The term covers any organised residential setup for site workers, from one dormitory beside a small project to a multi-building campus for a thousand-man workforce. On this page it means the campus version: several buildings, shared sanitation and cooking, planned circulation and security. One dormitory alone is better served by the specific building types below.

Three Building Types, One Decision

Choosing between the cluster's buildings is the real decision on this page. Where bed count per rupee decides, the open-hall dormitory building houses the most workers under one supervised roof. Where gangs need lockable privacy for long postings, room-based hutment blocks split every floor into separate rooms. And where the workforce follows the work, camp blocks built to relocate come down at one site and stand again at the next.

Six Approved Building Sizes

SizeBuilt areaWorkers (planning)Price ex-GST
60x24 ft G+12,880 sq ft58 to 72Rs 19,44,000
90x24 ft G+14,320 sq ft86 to 108Rs 29,16,000
90x24 ft G+26,480 sq ft129 to 162Rs 43,74,000
120x24 ft G+15,760 sq ft115 to 144Rs 38,88,000
118x30 ft G+17,080 sq ft142 to 177Rs 47,79,000
120x24 ft G+28,640 sq ft173 to 216Rs 58,32,000

Worker figures follow the standard occupancy planning basis; your approved layout sets the final number. G+1 means ground plus one floor, G+2 ground plus two.

How a Colony Goes Together

Dormitory buildings are laid out in separated rows with fire gaps engineered between, toilet and bath blocks placed by headcount rather than habit, and the kitchen positioned downwind with its own water and drainage. Internal roads take a water tanker at any corner. Gate cabins control entry, and for that we install our own gate security cabins, a different product doing a different job at the same site.

What the Buildings Are Made Of

The structural platform is selectable to the site: bolted MS and RHS panel framing for semi-permanent blocks, with RCC plinths where the colony will stand for years. Walls take PUF, EPS, rockwool or plain PPGI to the climate and budget, roofs are insulated PPGI or sandwich panel, and every specification row is listed openly in the Specifications tab. Nothing on the page is a brochure guess; it is the build standard our factories work to.

What a Colony Costs

Pricing is deliberately simple: a single Rs 675 per sq ft ex-GST figure applied to every size, so the table above is arithmetic, not negotiation. Fit-out packages and freight are quoted separately because they genuinely vary by site. Your fixed quotation reaches you inside 48 hours with the building placement drawn on your own plot dimensions.

Delivery and Standing Up the Site

Dispatch follows 7 to 21 working days behind drawing approval, from whichever facility is nearer your state. Buildings stand in sequence so the first dormitories house the crew that finishes the rest. The 5-year structural warranty and 1-year finishing warranty apply as standard, and service life runs 20 to 25 years under proper use and maintenance, which is not a warranty period but a design expectation.

Why Contractors Order Colonies From SAMAN

Because the site plan comes from a manufacturer, not a broker. We fabricate the buildings, so a change to room count or window position is a drawing revision, not a renegotiation. Founded in 2009 and incorporated in 2019, SAMAN POS India Private Limited runs its own facilities in Bengaluru and Greater Noida with a 200+ member team, ISO 9001, 14001 and 45001 certified.

Labour Colony FAQs

How many workers can one colony house?

A single building sleeps 58 to 216 on the planning basis; a campus of several buildings scales past a thousand. The layout drawing fixes the real figure.

Do you build the toilet blocks too?

Yes. Sanitation, kitchens and gate cabins are part of the colony scope and are quoted with the dormitories.

Can the colony grow later?

Yes. The services spine is planned once, and later buildings connect to it without reworking the first phase.

Is land preparation included?

Ground levelling and plinths are quoted per site after the plot details arrive with your enquiry.

What about statutory compliance?

Occupancy norms, exits and electrical protection are engineered into the drawings, and the pack includes what approvers ask to see.
